NOTIFY-1.name: NOT_A_BACKEND_NAME
NOTIFY-1.description: Raised when a back-end is added under a word that cannot name one.

NOTIFY-10.name: EVENTS_REFUSED
NOTIFY-10.description: Raised when an event arrives without the key the core gave its sender.

NOTIFY-2.name: BACKEND_NAME_TAKEN
NOTIFY-2.description: Raised when a back-end is added under a name another holds.

NOTIFY-3.name: NO_SUCH_BACKEND
NOTIFY-3.description: Raised when no back-end holds the name asked about.

NOTIFY-4.name: HOSTED_UNACKNOWLEDGED
NOTIFY-4.description: Raised when a back-end on a host that is not the household's own is added without saying so.

NOTIFY-5.name: NOT_A_BACKEND_ADDRESS
NOTIFY-5.description: Raised when a back-end's address is not one it can be reached at.

NOTIFY-6.name: BACKEND_INCOMPLETE
NOTIFY-6.description: Raised when a back-end is added without what its kind needs.

NOTIFY-7.name: NOT_A_RETRY_SCHEDULE
NOTIFY-7.description: Raised when a back-end's attempts and delays do not agree.

NOTIFY-8.name: NOT_OFFERED
NOTIFY-8.description: Raised when a member chooses a back-end that is not offered to members.

NOTIFY-9.name: NO_SUCH_WAKE
NOTIFY-9.description: Raised when a phone confirms a wake nobody sent it.
